scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Are you going to enter the ^0000FFDimensional Gap^000000?  Please use this Transport Device you see here.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
您要进入^0000FF次元裂缝^000000吗？请使用这里的传送装置。

scripts.text: What is the Dimensional Gap?
scripts.translation: 什么是次元裂缝？

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
As you know we've already entered through the Dimensional Rift to get to Ash Vacuum right?  The Dimensional Gap is an expansion of that initial discovery.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
你知道，我们之前就是通过次元裂缝前往阿什·巴库姆的，对吧？次元裂缝区域正是从那次发现进一步探索出来的。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
A member of the Expedition team found these backdoor passages to get through the Dimensional Rifts.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
远征队的一名成员发现了这些隐秘通道，可以穿过次元裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
This is like a Midgard Alliance version of the Bifrost bridge so it can connect us to different parts of the New World.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
这相当于米德加尔特联盟修建的彩虹桥，能把我们连接到新世界的各个区域。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Time and space is distorted in the Dimensional Gap.  Not all passageways have been discovered so please be sure to use caution when entering an unverified area.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
次元裂缝中的时空扭曲不定，而且并非所有通道都已探明。进入未经确认的区域时务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Anyone who has become lost here has yet to return.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
在这里迷路的人至今都未归来。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
请多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Please use a ^0000FFTransport Device^000000 if you wish to travel through the dimensional rift.  The insides have not been fully explored yet so please be careful in there.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
若要穿越次元裂缝，请使用^0000FF传送装置^000000。裂缝内部尚未完全探明，请务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Allied Forces Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to the Allied Forces ^0000FFExpedition Camp^000000 in Jotunheim.
scripts.translation:
[联合军士兵]
这条次元裂缝连接着约顿海姆的联合军^0000FF远征营地^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allied Forces Soldier]
Do not worry, it has been set up after testing hundreds of experiments for safe teleportation.
scripts.translation:
[联合军士兵]
请放心，这台装置经过数百次测试，确认可以安全传送后才投入使用。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to ^0000FFMorocc^000000 back in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克士兵]
这条次元裂缝连接着米德加尔特后方的^0000FF梦罗克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
This is the fastest gateway back to our world.  The area is still destroyed but restoration efforts will soon be on the way.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克士兵]
这是返回我们世界最快的通道。这里虽仍是一片废墟，但很快就会开始重建。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to the south of ^0000FFBifrost^000000.  It enables quick travel to the Splendide frontline.
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域士兵]
这条次元裂缝连接着^0000FF比弗罗斯特^000000的南部。
它可以让我们快速前往辉煌领域的前线。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
If we use it properly, it enables us to advance more easily to the capital of the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域士兵]
只要善加利用这条通道，我们就能更轻松地推进到萨法族的首都。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
The Mayor has asked us to cooperate as best we can instead of fighting, so I'm under orders not to do anything.  Since we have a common enemy we won't fight the Sapha... for now...
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域士兵]
市长命令我们尽可能与萨法族合作，避免冲突，所以我奉命按兵不动。既然我们有共同的敌人，暂时就不会和萨法族交战...

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Sapha]
This dimensional rift is connected to the southern area of the ^0000FFKamidal Mountains^000000 in El Dicastes.  I just dropped by for my research, but it is incredible.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的萨法族]
这条次元裂缝连接着埃尔迪卡特斯的^0000FF卡米达尔山脉^000000南部。我只是顺道来做研究，没想到这里竟如此惊人。

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Sapha]
Moreover it is next to the Laphine capital..... Hmm... Do not worry, I do not want to fight in such a place.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的萨法族]
而且这里紧邻拉菲涅族的首都.....嗯...别担心，我可不想在这种地方打起来。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
Welcome.  I am in charge of logistics to take care of your items in this weird place.  Do you need to access your storage?
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管]
欢迎。我负责管理这里的物资和仓储。需要使用仓库吗？

scripts.text: Open Storage 200 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 开启仓库（200 Zeny）

scripts.text: No Thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
You are not yet qualified to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管]
您还不符合使用仓库的条件。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
You need at least 200 zeny to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管]
使用仓库至少需要200 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
Let me know if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管]
如果您改变主意了，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Who're you?
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
What do you want?
You looking something in
particular?
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
你想干什么？
你在找什么特别的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
So some enforcers have been
cracking down on merchants lately.
I can not sell anything.
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
最近执法者在严查商人，我什么东西都卖不出去。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Come here...
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
过来...

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
I knew you would be here!!
No illegal trading is allowed
here!
Don't you know?
scripts.translation:
[紧张兮兮的骑士]
我就知道你会在这里！
这里不准非法交易！
你不知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Says who?
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
谁规定的？

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Ok, then show me your permit.
scripts.translation:
[神经紧张的骑士]
好吧，那就出示一下你的许可证。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Permit?
No one's in charge here!
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
许可证？
这里又没人管！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You! If you need anything come to
me ok?
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
喂！有需要就来找我，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
I will catch you!
scripts.translation:
[紧张兮兮的骑士]
我一定会抓住你的！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Cold juice!
Apple, grape, orange~
Anything you want!
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
冰镇果汁！
苹果、葡萄、橙子口味都有~
想喝什么尽管挑！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Sweet potato, dumpling~
Here we have delicious desserts~
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
烤红薯、饺子~
还有各种美味甜点~

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You need to pay a toll to get past here.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
你要通过这里，得交过路费。

scripts.text: What toll?
scripts.translation: 什么过路费？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You did not know?
500 zeny
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
你不知道吗？
500 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
You there!
Stop right there!
scripts.translation:
[神经紧张的骑士]
喂！
站住！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Ugh! How are you always following me?
Got some kind of crush on me or something? I don't think you and I make a good match...
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
啧！你怎么总跟着我？
该不会是对我有意思吧？我可不觉得咱俩合适...

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Why don't we find out then?
scripts.translation:
[紧张兮兮的骑士]
那不如试试看？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
That's it no more talking.
I'm outta here~
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
行了，不跟你废话了。
我先走啦~

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Keep running you sneaky coward!
scripts.translation:
[紧张兮兮的骑士]
有种别跑，你这个狡猾的胆小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
500 zeny
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
500 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You are lucky that you have met up
with me.
Who am I?
I'm here to become a merchant
King.
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
能遇见我，算你走运。
我是谁？
我来这里是为了将来成为商界之王。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
I might be working a street stall
now but I'll have an actual shop
some day.
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
我现在虽然只摆着路边摊，
但总有一天会开一家正经店铺。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
It's my first day so I'm having a
major sale.
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
今天是我开张第一天，所有商品大减价！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Let's see I've got a...
Ring of something!
Sword of stuff!
A backpack of some sort!
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
让我看看...我这儿有：
什么什么戒指！
什么什么剑！
还有一个不知名的背包！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Tell me if you need anything,
scripts.translation:
[王子卡内特]
需要什么尽管告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
What are you doing here?
This is my spot for a shop
Get outta my turf!
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
你在这里做什么？
这是我的摊位。
滚出我的地盘！

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Bah!!
You're gonna regret those words!
scripts.translation:
[神经紧张的骑士]
哼！！
你会后悔说这种话的！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
I'm shaking...
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
我在发抖...

scripts.text:
[Curious Knight]
The Royal Guard in here
was desperate for help.
We entered through a secret place
in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[好奇的骑士]
这里的皇家卫士急需援助。
我们是从宫殿的一处秘密通道进来的。

scripts.text:
[Curious Knight]
We were whisked away here...
No idea where I am but I have to
establish a base here for the
Knighthood.
scripts.translation:
[好奇的骑士]
我们突然就被带到了这里...
我不知道这是哪里，但必须在此建立骑士团的据点。

scripts.text:
[Confused Thief]
One minute I'm in a bar...
The next minute I'm here...
What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[困惑的盗贼]
前一刻我还在酒馆...
转眼就到了这里...
这到底是什么地方？

scripts.text:
[Confused Thief]
There's no night or day in here.
Hmm, something has to be valuable
in this place...
scripts.translation:
[困惑的盗贼]
这里没有白天和黑夜之分。
嗯，这个地方一定有什么值钱的东西...

scripts.text:
[Adventurous Rafflesia]
No no this has to be Thanatos
Tower...
I sense dark magic here.
scripts.translation:
[爱冒险的大王花]
不，这里一定是塔纳托斯之塔...
我感受到了黑暗魔力。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Oh, we're back here again.
I cannot find a way out!
We are trapped in this maze!
scripts.translation:
[向导]
哎呀，我们又回到这里了。
我找不到出口！
我们被困在这个迷宫里了！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Is this place the famous Prontera?
It is dark just like a big city!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
这里是著名的普隆德拉吗？
黑漆漆的，倒真像一座大城市！

scripts.text:
[Traveller]
I hear a ticking clock.
This place must be Geffen!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我听见了时钟的滴答声。
这里一定是吉芬！

scripts.text:
